newsitem.title: USA: Schuler sees variability in sales, net.
newsitem.headline: Schuler sees variability in sales, net.

text.p: Schuler Homes Inc said Wednesday it has experienced, and expects to continue to experience, significant variability in sales and net income.
The company said numerous factors contribute to this variability.
The company said its historical performance is not necessarily a meaningful indicator of future results and, in general, the company's financial results will vary from development to development.

Last month the company announced the completion of its acquisition of Melody Homes Inc, a homebuilder and 43-year old company in the Denver metropolitan area, and Melody Mortgage Company, a mortgage brokerage firm for Melody home buyers.

As it enters 1997, the company said it will continue to focus on its leading market position in Hawaii, as it looks forward to the positive impact to its financial results from its recent Denver acquisition and initial deliveries from its new Northern California and Northwest divisions.
